items.event_time_ist: Remarks ~1:00 PM local Oct 14 (12:45 AM IST Oct 15) in Bullhead City, AZ; ~6:15 PM local Oct 14 (6:45 AM IST Oct 15) in Kalispell, MT
items.summary: Trump's red-state blitz continues Wed Oct 14 with two rallies missed by earlier sweeps: Bullhead City, AZ (Laughlin Bullhead Int'l Airport; doors 9:30 AM, remarks ~1 PM local) with GOP governor nominee Andy Biggs — Arizona is one of five Dem-held governorships in Trump-2024 states; then Kalispell, MT (Majestic Valley Arena, remarks ~6:15 PM local) for Aaron Flint in the tight MT-1 House race vs Sam Forstag (replacing retiring Rep. Ryan Zinke). Mohave County went 77% Trump in 2024; Trump's day begins in Las Vegas. Falls on a week when Trump's approval is at its lowest per polls and GOP strategists say the national map is being contested seat-by-seat.
items.title: Trump double-header Wednesday: Bullhead City, AZ (with Biggs) then Kalispell, MT (for Flint in tight MT-1)
